notablePrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Simic Growth Chamber.
description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding {G/U}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Simic Growth Chamber.
Repeat.
